_comment: Canonical, agent-neutral definition of our DIY MCP servers. Packages use @latest so every agent start follows the newest release. The installer translates this into each agent's native config format. Tokens are NEVER written into configs: servers with token_env are launched through secret_wrapper, which reads claude-mcp:<token_env> from the OS secret store (see bin/with-secret). Never commit real tokens.

sciverse.note: Scientific literature search. Token REQUIRED; missing = unusable (401).

mineru-cloud.note: Cloud document parsing; UPLOADS documents to mineru.net, so agents must get user consent per request. Token optional (wrapped with --optional): without one the server runs in free Flash mode (<=20p/10MB, single file).
